New Ration Card Application
Required documents
1. Aadhaar card of all family members
2. Address proof (electricity bill / rent agreement)
3. Income certificate
4. Bank passbook (first page)
5. Passport-size family photograph
6. Deletion certificate (if migrated)
7. Mobile number linked to Aadhaar
